conditions.condition: Replicated CREATE with a stored generated expression, then multirow INSERT with a non-NULL input and a NULL input; verify exact generated values and NULL propagation.
UPDATE the non-NULL base column and verify the stored generated value changes.
DELETE the updated row while the NULL row remains; verify its generated value is NULL and verify retained rows.
Replicated CREATE TABLE with an integer primary key, nullable TEXT and FULLTEXT KEY ft(body) WITH PARSER ngram; establish its schema through captured CREATE before its first row write.
Multirow INSERT of (1,'xyzzy') and (2,'qqvvq'); a BOOLEAN MODE search for xyzzy returns only row 1.
UPDATE row 1 to rrwwr; a BOOLEAN MODE search for xyzzy returns no rows.
DELETE row 2; a BOOLEAN MODE search for qqvvq returns no rows.
Replicated CREATE of id INT PRIMARY KEY and v INT NOT NULL, without a secondary key; retain a separate table from nullable UNIQUE-key tests.
One INSERT creates (1,10),(2,20),(3,30); check all rows and exact values.
One UPDATE doubles v for ids 1 and 2; check (1,20),(2,40),(3,30), including unaffected id 3.
One DELETE removes ids 1 and 3; check that only (2,40) remains.
Replicated CREATE with PRIMARY KEY(report_date,id), declared columns id then report_date, and nullable VARCHAR(40) payload.
Insert equal ids on different dates and a different id on the same date; check every row.
Change only the date key part for id 7 on 2026-01-01; retain the other id 7 row and the unaffected id 8 row.
Change only the integer key part from 7 to 9 on 2026-01-02; retain the other date and unaffected row.
DELETE by both key parts; check both remaining rows and their payloads.
Replicated CREATE with VARCHAR(20) PRIMARY KEY and utf8mb4_unicode_ci, plus a nullable INT value.
Insert Key and other; check exact key bytes and values.
Change Key to KEY and value to 3; check exact key bytes and the unaffected row.
DELETE with lowercase key matches stored KEY under utf8mb4_unicode_ci; only other remains.
Replicated CREATE with INT PRIMARY KEY, non-NULL INT value and UNIQUE KEY uk(v).
Insert (1,10),(2,20) as the independent starting state.
One statement changes the duplicate primary-key row to (1,11) and inserts (3,30), while (2,20) remains.
Repeat (1,11) with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE; check all exact rows remain unchanged.
Replicated CREATE with INT PRIMARY KEY, non-NULL INT value and UNIQUE KEY uk(v).
Insert (1,10),(2,20) as a separate starting state.
REPLACE (1,20),(3,30) conflicts with two different existing rows through PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE KEY; check only (1,20),(3,30) remain.
Replicated CREATE with INT PRIMARY KEY, non-NULL INT value and UNIQUE KEY uk(v).
Insert only (1,10) as a separate starting state.
INSERT IGNORE skips (1,11) on primary key and (3,10) on unique key, but inserts (2,20).
INSERT IGNORE (1,99) changes no rows; check both original rows remain unchanged.
